headline: OpenAI Loses Bid to Block Singapore Startup's GemGPT Trademark
summary: ChatGPT creator OpenAI lost its bid to block Singapore-based Porolis from registering the GemGPT trademark for its AI-powered gemstone authentication and related software services.
why: Intellectual property disputes and trademark registrations are critical for technology firms protecting their brand identities in international markets.

impacts.name: OpenAI
impacts.why: Trademark decision allows the Singapore startup to proceed with GemGPT registration.
